latest_release.name: v0.72.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Refactor `DeclEngine` for robustness and semantic consistency by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7704
* Bump quinn-proto from 0.11.14 to 0.11.16 in /test/src/sdk-harness by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7700
* Fix `copy_prop_reverse` cycle detection by @xunilrj in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7702
* Split AST to ASM compilation phase to AST -> IR -> ASM by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7713
* Implement `type_check_finalize` for `DeclEngine` optimization by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7714
* Add `has_changes_scoped!` and fix emitting of scoped errors by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7716
* Improve `inline` heuristic to avoid the final inlined function to be too big by @xunilrj in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7710
* docs: versioning clarity, measured performance guidance, and fail-closed publishing by @pixelcircuits in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7719
* Remove obsolete `CFEI`/`CFSI` optimization from ASM generation by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7721
* Freeze data section layout during `AllocatedProgram` compilation by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7727
* Bump to 0.72.1 by @ironcev in https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/pull/7728


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FuelLabs/sway/compare/v0.72.0...v0.72.1
